summary: Conrad Earnest was last seen July 19 in the Glade Park area photographing the NEOWISE comet; reported missing July 23; deputies searched overnight; his car was found ~10:30am Friday at Miracle Rock campground and his body was found shortly after on the Miracle Rock hiking trail; unattended death, no foul play suspected.
location: Miracle Rock trail, Glade Park, Mesa County
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office, Mesa County Search
notes: Reported missing July 23, 2020; body found Friday morning July 24, 2020. [run 703: KVNF corroborating URL merged — newscast confirms body of missing man Conrad Earnest found deceased by SAR crew on Miracle Rock Trail]
